scenarios.description: Verify the immutable archive digest, pack UUIDs, and pack versions.
assertions: The observed candidate ID matches the active campaign.
Behavior and resource UUIDs and versions match the frozen candidate.

scenarios.description: Import and activate both mutually dependent packs without cache fallback.
assertions: Both packs are active.
The world does not load an older cached pack.

scenarios.description: Boot the Script API runtime and inspect the Windows Content Log.
assertions: Content Log contains no errors.
Warnings are absent or explicitly allowlisted.
Script API 2.5.0 and UI API 2.0.0 initialize.

scenarios.description: Acquire migrated blocks and items through their declared survival paths.
assertions: Registered content is obtainable.
Drops and inventory quantities are correct.

scenarios.description: Verify localized names, tooltips, forms, and guide navigation.
assertions: No raw localization key is shown.
Guide forms remain navigable with the active input device.

scenarios.description: Run recipe mapping, machine processing, random output, and recovery cases.
assertions: Inputs, outputs, chances, and heat requirements match the catalog.
Interrupted jobs recover without duplication or loss.

scenarios.description: Exercise fluid capacity, ports, valves, competition, boilers, and heat sources.
assertions: Fluid volume is conserved.
Direction, valve, heat, and restart rules remain authoritative.

scenarios.description: Exercise speed, direction, stress, overload, propagation, and restart recovery.
assertions: Network speed and direction are deterministic.
Overload and restored networks fail closed.

scenarios.description: Exercise native redstone, links, requesters, controllers, gauges, and displays.
assertions: Native producer and consumer updates propagate.
Controller configuration and displayed values survive reload.

scenarios.description: Exercise transport, filters, full endpoints, reversal, packages, and escrow.
assertions: Item and package quantities are conserved.
Concurrent or disconnected transfers recover exactly once.

scenarios.description: Assemble, move, interrupt, reload, and paste dynamic structures.
assertions: Moved content is neither duplicated nor lost.
Assembly, contacts, actors, and schematic recovery preserve state.

scenarios.description: Exercise track graphs, signals, schedules, carriage state, riding, and reconnect.
assertions: Conflicting routes fail closed.
Schedules, carriage spacing, riding, and cargo state recover.

scenarios.description: Exercise wrench, toolbox, backtank, potato cannon, Extendo Grip, and equipment durability.
assertions: Equipment behavior and durability match documented Bedrock semantics.
Controller and hotbar interactions work with the active input device.

scenarios.description: Inspect core models, textures, animations, sounds, and particle events.
assertions: No missing texture, model, or blocking animation defect is visible.
Representative sound and particle families trigger.

scenarios.description: Compare configured, in-flight, and restored checkpoints across unload and restart.
assertions: Inventory, fluid, kinetic, contraption, and train state is recoverable.
No transaction commits twice.

scenarios.description: Operate shared endpoints and moving systems from two clients.
assertions: Concurrent actions do not duplicate, lose, or deadlock state.
Both clients converge on the authoritative result.

scenarios.description: Distribute the frozen packs through Realm and reconnect all client types.
assertions: Clients automatically receive the frozen packs.
Disconnect and reconnect preserve player and world state.

scenarios.description: Run a two-player 30-minute mixed-domain stability observation.
assertions: No crash, watchdog termination, or unrecoverable disconnect occurs.
Kernel, scheduler, and dynamic-property metrics remain bounded.
